data.desc: YYForce Inc. (NASDAQ: YFOR) is an innovative technology enterprise redefining workforce management, integrated facility services, and commercial operations through AI-enabled platforms and autonomous robotics. Leveraging proprietary marketplace tech, intelligent staffing algorithms, and smart robotics deployment, YYForce empowers enterprise clients across hospitality, logistics, healthcare, and commercial real estate to optimize productivity, enhance service delivery, and navigate the future of work.
